verdict.rationale: The firm's own Tech and Digital Solutions page documents a 'Deal Room', a secure virtual data room hosted externally on HighQ. That covers secure client document sharing for deals, but it is a deal data room rather than a general matter portal or extranet. missing for 10: matter tracking and status visibility for clients, a general client extranet beyond deal data rooms, detail on security and access features, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm offers a secure client portal or extranet for matters, documents, and status, documented on its own pages

citations.quote: A secure virtual data room, hosted externally on an industry-leading platform provided by HighQ
